title: Coala: a standard-based framework for converting CWL-described command-line tools into agentic toolsets
creator: Hu Q.
normalized_title: coala a standard based framework for converting cwl described command line tools into agentic toolsets
V61_REASON: Bridges MCP and CWL, exposes validated schemas, runs tools in containerized environments, and explicitly separates agent reasoning from tool execution.
